failed_or_abandoned: Poisson model with P(exactly 1 | mu_U) = L_U for the unknown-background hypothesis cannot represent L_U = 0.5 (max of mu e^-mu is 0.368); L_U is therefore treated as a given likelihood in the posterior tables and P(>=1 | mu_U) = L_U is used only for the forward projection.

No attempt to reconstruct the 2D signal/background PDFs to obtain the true density ratio at the event (left to P052 in the corpus plan); the paper's 3.4 sigma was instead inverted to an effective single-event background b_eff = 3.4e-4 (exact Poisson) to 1.1e-3 (asymptotic LR).
The dataviz skill's node.js palette validator was not run (simulation restricts execution to .venv python); the pre-validated reference palette values were used instead.
